name: net.subscriby/mcp
description: Subscriby MCP — manage projects, plans, members, payments, connectors and analytics for creators who run paid communities on connected platforms. Sign in with OAuth or use a personal access token.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Leave unset to sign in with OAuth 2.1 when the client asks (the server publishes its authorization metadata and registers clients dynamically). Set to "Bearer <personal-access-token>" to connect with a token minted at https://app.subscriby.net/settings/tokens carrying only the abilities you choose.
